summary: Iteration 2 full-stack test of Shivshaktiloto. Backend: 26 pytest cases across health, public board (63 slots, IST reveal logic, latest_slot_index, schedule cadence 15min/10min), board by date (today/past/future/invalid), dates list, JWT auth (login success/case-insensitive/wrong password/unknown user/422/me/no-token/bad-token/protected 401), slot override validation + persistence, regenerate. All 26 pass AFTER fixing a critical MongoDB positional-update bug found during testing. Frontend: Home board (white theme, A/B/C = red/green/blue verified via computed styles, 32 revealed + 31 dashes matching IST time, Latest Draw banner matched last revealed row), history date picker + 'Live today', 404 error state, admin login (wrong creds toast 'Invalid credentials' + stays on page; correct creds -> /admin), admin panel 63 editable colored rows, per-row Save persisting to public board, input sanitization, Regenerate, Sign out, protected-route redirect. All frontend flows pass except the admin future-slot editing defect below.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: query used {'slots.hour': h, 'slots.minute': m} with the positional '$' operator, so MongoDB matched the first element satisfying ANY condition and wrote to the WRONG slot (e.g. updating 10:00 PM overwrote 9:00 AM). Replaced with $elemMatch. Regression test added: /app/backend/tests/test_slot_positional_bug.py

minor.issue: No admin-visible variant: unrevealed slot values are masked (a/b/c null) for everyone, so the admin panel cannot load/see future slot numbers (see frontend bug). Recommend an authenticated endpoint (or ?full=1 for admins) returning unmasked slots.

No brute-force lockout / rate limiting (playbook expects lockout after 5 failed attempts). 8 consecutive wrong-password attempts all returned 401 with no throttling, and a valid login immediately after returned 200 (no lockout).
allow_origins comes from CORS_ORIGINS='*' while allow_credentials=True. Wildcard + credentials is invalid for cookie-based auth and overly permissive; set explicit origins.
Playbook expects httpOnly cookie session; implementation returns a JWT stored in localStorage (XSS-exposed, no server-side revocation). Acceptable if intentional, but deviates from the auth playbook.

ui_bugs.issue: Future (unrevealed) slots render EMPTY inputs because the API masks their values. Clicking Save on such a row silently writes 00/00/00 (String('').padStart(2,'0') === '00') and shows a success toast — destroying that slot's generated numbers. Reproduced: saved 10:00 PM row untouched -> toast 'Saved 10:00 PM' and 00/00/00 written. Fix: load unmasked data for admin and/or block save when any input is empty.

issues: Page overflows horizontally (scrollWidth 403 > clientWidth 390): the letter-spaced SHIVSHAKTILOTO h1 is wider than the viewport and is clipped on the right
Uses native browser <input type='date'> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component available in the project
No indication of which rows are already revealed vs upcoming, making accidental overwrites of live results easy

action_items: Fix AdminPanel future-slot editing: fetch unmasked values for admin (new/authenticated endpoint) and disable Save when any of a/b/c is empty instead of padding to '00'
Add brute-force lockout / rate limiting on POST /api/auth/login (playbook requirement)
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' while allow_credentials=True
Fix mobile horizontal overflow of the SHIVSHAKTILOTO headline (<=390px)
Optional: replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar; mark revealed vs upcoming rows in admin table
Review tester's backend fix in PUT /api/board/slot ($elemMatch) and keep the regression test
critical_code_review_comments: Never combine dotted multi-field array filters with the positional '$' operator — always use $elemMatch (this caused wrong-slot writes).
AdminPanel.saveRow pads empty strings to '00' silently; validate emptiness before padStart.
bcrypt hash verified in DB as $2b$12$ (60 chars) and seed_admin correctly re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes — both good.

Board reveal logic is computed server-side per request (good), but consider a compound unique index on boards.date to make ensure_board race-safe (currently relies on exception handling with no unique index).

success_rate.backend: 100% (26/26 after tester fix; 1 critical defect found)

seed_data_creation: Inserted a past-date board for 2026-08-04 into MongoDB 'boards' to exercise the history date picker (all slots revealed). Today's board (2026-08-05) was regenerated during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives in /app/backend/tests/ (backend_test.py + test_slot_positional_bug.py); run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -p no:randomly. Tester already fixed the $elemMatch bug in PUT /api/board/slot. Remaining known open defect: AdminPanel saving an unedited future slot writes 00/00/00 — re-verify by logging in at /admin, checking admin-row-62-a is populated, and that Save is blocked when inputs are empty. Past-date board 2026-08-04 is seeded for history testing.
rca_of_the_issue: MongoDB's positional '$' operator resolves to the first array element matching the query; with {'slots.hour': h, 'slots.minute': m} the two conditions can be satisfied by different elements, so '$' pointed at the first element matching either condition (e.g. index 0 with minute=0) instead of the intended (hour, minute) pair. Any admin override of a slot other than 9:00 AM corrupted the wrong row. Fixed with {'slots': {'$elemMatch': {...}}}; verified with a regression test asserting 12:00 PM updates while 9:00 AM stays unchanged.
